model_system: monolayer Fe2Se2Cl (single-side Cl-adsorbed FeSe monolayer), with hole doping; also a 10-layer slab for bulk-limit robustness

key_params.adsorption_site: Cl directly above top Se atom (Site 1)
key_params.energy_difference_undoped: dimer is 24.186 meV/Fe lower than checkerboard at 3.796 Å
key_params.energy_difference_at_0.25_hole_per_Fe: checkerboard is 12.19 meV/Fe lower than dimer

headline_claim: Giant altermagnetic spin splitting up to 620 meV in hole-doped monolayer Fe2Se2Cl.
replication_difficulty: medium — standard first-principles workflow, but requires careful magnetic-state enumeration, charged-doping setup, and slab/stability calculations.
